subject: NorthBridge: SIG/CAIQ — request for log retention exception and evidence
messages:
From: Sheila Martin <sheila.martin@northbridgehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: NorthBridge Security <security@northbridgehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG/CAIQ follow-up — log retention, deletion evidence, and temporary hold request

Ben —

Thanks for the demo yesterday. Our security team reviewed Redwood's SIG and CAIQ and asked for clarification on how you handle tenant-scoped logs and deletion proofs. Two specific asks we need to close for our upcoming compliance audit: 

1) For ephemeral session traces and inference debug logs, what is the default retention and what artifacts do you produce to prove deletion? We need a sample deletion record (ID, job run id, timestamp, object identifier) and a short description of the purge workflow.

2) We have an audit that begins in June. For a small group of tenants we may need to request a temporary extension to retain certain debug traces up to 12 months. Please outline the process to request an exception, the controls you put around extended retention (access controls, timeboxing, logging), and any cost/impact.

I've attached the partially-completed SIG template and a short scope doc (see attachments). Can you advise on next steps and what evidence you can supply by May 1?

Sheila Martin
Head of Security, NorthBridge Health
sheila.martin@northbridgehealth.com
+1 415-555-0132

Attachments: NBH_SIG_Template_filled.xlsx
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sheila Martin <sheila.martin@northbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ follow-up — log retention, deletion evidence, and temporary hold request

Sheila —

Thanks — looping in Priya (InfoSec) and Karthik (Platform) to get the detailed artifacts and a proposed exception path. We can deliver a deletion-sample CSV and a retention policy excerpt by May 1.

Priya/Karthik — see Sheila's asks above. Quick plan: 1) Priya to confirm SOC 2/SIG mappings and the standard artifacts we supply; 2) Karthik to provide the technical description of retention buckets and deletion records; 3) I'll assemble an addendum template and cost/controls language for a 12-month, timeboxed retention.

Sheila — we'll aim to send the artifacts + a proposed limited retention addendum for your review by May 1. If you prefer a short call to walk through the artifacts, happy to schedule next week.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
+1 415-555-0199
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ follow-up — log retention, deletion evidence, and temporary hold request

Ben / Karthik —

Notes for the artifact pack we will provide to NorthBridge: 

- Default retention: 
  - Inference output & prompt metadata (tenant-level): 30 days (ephemeral by default).
  - Session traces (short-lived debugging captures): 30 days.
  - Authentication and admin audit logs: 365 days (for compliance).

- Deletion evidence we can produce: 
  - Deletion job record (job_id, run_timestamp, tenant_id, object_key_patterns)
  - Proof-of-delete manifest (SHA256 of deleted object list, deletion-run id)
  - Sample log extract showing object purge events: redwood_log_sample_20270410.csv
  - CAIQ/SIG mapping extract referencing the retention controls (will attach a policy extract PDF).

- Exception process: 
  1) Customer sends formal request to their AE (Ben) with scope (tenant ids, log types, timeframe).
  2) InfoSec & Platform review for control compensations (RBAC, timebox, read-only evidence access).
  3) Legal approves addendum; engineering implements tenant-scoped TTL override (timeboxed) and an audit trail.

Controls for timeboxed retention: 
- Tenant-scoped key tagging + access only to a small SRE subset (role-based).
- Timebox enforced via scheduled deletion job with immutable run records.
- Additional monitoring for any exports and monthly review reports to customer.

Open items / caveats: 
- Implementing a per-tenant extension for ephemeral traces requires a short engineering ticket (2-3 sprints depending on queue) if it does not already exist for the tenant. We can provide a temporary workaround (export-and-retain under customer-managed bucket) while engineering schedules the TTL override.
- Cost: we will include an estimated incremental storage charge for longer retention in the addendum.

I'll attach the retention-policy excerpt (redwood_retention_policy.pdf) and a sample CSV with purge events. Karthik — please add the deletion job technical details (mechanism, KMS handling, manifest format).

Priya Natarajan
Director, Information Security
priya_natarajan@redwood.com
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 18 Apr 2027 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ follow-up — log retention, deletion evidence, and temporary hold request

Priya / Ben —

Technical details to include in the evidence pack: 

1) Log categories and storage location:
   - inference-traces (tenant-scoped): stored in cold object store (encrypted at rest via customer-specific KMS keys where requested). Default TTL is 30d enforced by lifecycle rules.
   - ephemeral-session-traces: stored in short-term object buckets; TTL enforced by TTL-worker service.
   - audit/admin logs: stored in write-once buckets with 365d retention.

2) Deletion workflow and artifacts: 
   - Deletion job (deletion_worker_v2) runs nightly. Each run emits a manifest: {run_id, start_ts, end_ts, tenant_id, object_prefixes, sha256_manifest}.
   - We persist the manifest in a retained audit store (immutable) and expose a read-only manifest for customers on request.
   - Sample manifest row (to be included in CSV): run_id=del-20270410-007, tenant_id=nbh-prod-01, deleted_prefix=tenants/nbh-prod-01/inference-traces/, timestamp=2027-04-10T02:11:08Z, sha256=3f4c...

3) KMS and key rotation:
   - Customer-managed KMS is supported for Dedicated/Private deployments; for Hosted, we use region keys rotated quarterly. Deletion of objects does not delete KMS keys (separate process), but we can provide key-wrapping evidence.

4) Implementation notes for 12-month exception:
   - Short-term workaround: export tenant-specific traces to a customer-managed bucket (bucket ACL + lifecycle) — fast to stand up and minimal engineering.
   - Full platform support: implement tenant TTL override flag + guardrails (RBAC + timebox) — estimated 2 sprints for gated rollout + QA.

I'll attach the sample CSV (redwood_log_sample_20270410.csv) and the manifest template. We should also prepare a short cost summary for Ben to include in the addendum.

Karthik
Senior Staff Engineer, Platform
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Sheila Martin <sheila.martin@northbridgehealth.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 19 Apr 2027 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ follow-up — log retention, deletion evidence, and temporary hold request

Sheila —

Attached is the evidence pack we discussed: 
- redwood_retention_policy.pdf (policy extract with CAIQ mapping)
- redwood_log_sample_20270410.csv (sample deletion manifest rows)
- NBH_SIG_Template_filled.xlsx (your partially-completed SIG with our answers)

Summary / proposal: 
- Default behavior: inference & session traces = 30d, admin/audit logs = 365d.
- We can support a timeboxed 12-month retention for the tenant-scope you specify. Options: 
  A) Quick: export-and-store in a customer-managed bucket (we provide access controls + manifest).
  B) Platform: tenant TTL override + RBAC + immutable manifests (requires engineering; ETA ~2 sprints).

Controls we will apply for option B (platform): 
- Tenant-scoped retention tag, enforced deletion job with run manifest.
- Access limited to 2 SREs + InfoSec (read-only for customer).
- Monthly deletion-run reports and one-time audit evidence package at end of retention window.

Cost/impact: incremental storage and retention operational support. I will include a nominal storage uplift estimate in an addendum. If you confirm scope (tenant ids and object categories) we will put together a DocuSign addendum and a timeline (fast path via export or engineering route).

Next step: please confirm which tenant(s) you want in scope and whether you prefer the export work-around or the platform change. Once we have scope we will send the addendum for signature.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood_retention_policy.pdf, redwood_log_sample_20270410.csv, NBH_SIG_Template_filled.xlsx
From: Sheila Martin <sheila.martin@northbridgehealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: NorthBridge Security <security@northbridgehealth.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG/CAIQ follow-up — log retention, deletion evidence, and temporary hold request

Ben / Priya / Karthik —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the artifacts — very helpful. We reviewed the sample manifest and retention-policy extract; that gives our auditors what they need for the majority of controls.

Decision: we'll proceed with the export-and-store workaround for now (customer-managed bucket) for 4 tenants: nbh-prod-01, nbh-prod-02, nbh-stage-01, nbh-stage-02. Please prepare a short addendum and DocuSign for the export approach (timeboxed to 12 months) and include the incremental storage estimate. I'm copying our security mailbox so they can confirm any narrow access constraints.

Attached: northbridge_request_form.pdf (signed by our compliance lead) — please use that as the formal scope request.

Sheila
Sheila Martin
Head of Security, NorthBridge Health

Attachments: northbridge_request_form.pdf
